name: Survivor Strain
source:
It's been two years since the so-called first wave, where hordes of infected got everything in their path. During this time, countries fought with all they had in order to stop it. Many succeded, and many were completely lost. The story begins two years after those events in South America, in a resilient country in the south.

Due to the outbreak, several creatures and mutations have been spotted roaming in the so-called red zones, areas that were lost during the outbreak. You will face several events while exploring these areas. People who prefer a lawless life and creatures evolved to hunt. Only the bravest adventure there, but few people return, even though people do it out of necessity...

This is the story of how you try to survive and adapt to that new world.

[From [url=https://mrbaker95.itch.io/somewhere-i-belong]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
距离所谓的第一波浪潮已经过去两年了，当时成群结队的感染者遭遇了一切阻碍。在此期间，各国竭尽全力阻止它。许多人成功了，许多人完全迷失了。故事开始于这些事件发生两年后，发生在南美洲一个有恢复力的南部国家。

由于疫情爆发，人们发现一些生物和突变体在所谓的红色区域中游荡，这些区域在疫情爆发期间消失了。在探索这些区域时，你将面临一些事件。喜欢无法无天的生活的人们和生物进化为狩猎。那里只有最勇敢的冒险，但很少有人回来，即使人们这样做是出于必要……

这是一个关于你如何努力生存和适应新世界的故事。

[来自[url=https://mrbaker95.itch.io/somewhere-i-belong]Itch.io[/url]]
